summary.text: Sheoldred, the Whispering One, is the praetor of the black faction of New Phyrexia who led the invasion of Dominaria.

bio.text: She earned her praetor position by manipulating the other thanes against each other, and took control of the Dross Pits after outsmarting Roxith.
Elesh Norn laid waste to her domain, after which Sheoldred served Norn in the multiversal invasions.
She arrived in the Caves of Koilos on Dominaria and was rebuilt by Rona and the Society of Mishra, then mass-produced sleeper agents, resurrected Ertai and compleated Ajani Goldmane.
At the Battle of the Mana Rig she attacked on a dragon engine and captured Karn.
A Planar Bridge carried Sheoldred, Ajani and Karn away from the exploding Rig, and Tezzeret carried her back to her lair in the Dross Pits.
She then moved against Elesh Norn and allied with Urabrask's rebellion, so Norn declared her an apostate and Ajani captured her.
Brought before Norn, she was decapitated by Ajani, the first known death of a New Phyrexian praetor.

status.text: Sheoldred is dead, executed by Ajani on Elesh Norn's order.
